svg.title: IsaA S194, Pyk T537 and QoxB T552 phosphosites
svg.desc: Three structures extracted from the original report. The embedded structure images preserve the PDF views. Vector arrows and labels identify the JE2 sites and groups.

g.text: AlphaFold reference models (NCTC 8325) · Arrow labels use JE2 residue numbers
Yellow circled residues mark the phosphosites
